correctness.rationale: Using the integral elementary-symmetric model e1=0,e3=0 (the power-sum cubic degenerates mod 3), independently recomputed the ordinary 4x4 Hessian det(e3)=e4 in F3, and the local 3x3 quartic Hessians at pair-support and one-versus-four representatives both have nonzero determinant 1. The common cubic-gradient equation X_i^3+e2 X_i=c implies all geometric singularities arise from F3 patterns with 2 or 5 nonzero coordinates, exactly 10+5 rational A1 nodes. Independently enumerated all projective points of H over F3 and F9 using explicit extension arithmetic, obtaining 25,145; the split nodal exceptional P1s add 3*15 and 9*15 to get 70,280. K3 cohomology has twenty-two eigenvalues alpha_i of complex absolute value 3. The normalized second power trace 198/9=22 forces every alpha_i/3=+/-1 via equality in triangle inequality, while trace 60/3=20 gives 21 plus and one minus. Hence the all-extension zeta and Picard ranks via Tate; finite point counts alone would not extrapolate without this cohomological argument.
